label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, when the agent is choosing a1
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, never at D1 or D2. 94% of activation mass comes after an unrewarded previous trial (in_rew 0 at D1), and 85% when the policy picks a1 (policy logit for a1 high; 54% of mass is in the top choice bin, choice > 8). It almost never fires after a rewarded trial or when the agent picks a2. GO & prev_reward==0 alone gives mass recall 0.94 but precision 0.34. Adding the agent own choice (model_act==1, its argmax policy output at that step, so observed and not future) gives dev F1 0.60, mass recall 0.79. Rate also grows over the episode: it is low in trials 0-30 and highest around trials 60-90, so the unit is weak early on. Adding conditions on the trial before (r1 then r0), on episode time, or on the hidden good state raised precision but cost more recall. Many unrewarded a1 GO steps stay silent, so the unit is not fully explained by observed variables. Magnitude is largest for confident a1 choices after no reward.
